design.band_convention: b cycles per 32 samples; x(t) = sqrt(2) cos(2 pi b t/32 + phi)
design.seed_rule: cell seed = SEED_BASE + grid index (+ arm offset for sanity)
design.projection: torch.linalg.lstsq on [cos(2 pi b t/32), sin(2 pi b t/32)]; closed form (2/K) B^T x asserted equal at integer b
design.complex_metric: khat = zhat_b / z_b with z = c[0] - i c[1], c the least-squares coefficients on [cos, sin] (the coefficient of exp(i 2 pi b t/32)); a tone A cos(2 pi b t/32 + psi) reads z = A exp(i psi) and a model output g*tone(psi+delta) reads khat = g exp(i delta), at any non-Nyquist b (asserted); at integer b Re(khat) == retained's khat and |khat|^2 == r
design.dk_definition: dk_mean = |mean_n khat_n - 1| (phase-averaged complex ratio); dk_abs_mean = mean_n |khat_n - 1|
design.phase_err_sign: arg(khat) > 0 means the forecast leads the tone
design.nyquist_note: b=16 is the 32-sample Nyquist: sin(2 pi 16 t/32) vanishes identically, the basis is rank 1 and the read-out is degenerate/inflated (self-image); flagged, not interpreted
design.bolt_context_note: both models probed at context 512; Bolt's native context is 2048
